nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 卡鲁拉森林的阳光刚刚还穿过树冠，一阵骤雨便把步道变成了闪亮的绿色迷宫。路标上的一支箭也被风吹歪了。

nodes.speaker: Wanjiku
nodes.text: The rain is normal. A bent sign is not. Let's confirm the route before the group follows it.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 一位护林员在雨棚下整理地图。你们需要说明出发点、目标和眼前的问题。

options.text: 「We came from Gate A and we're heading to the waterfall. Is this the right path?」

nodes.speaker: 护林员
nodes.text: Good details. Take the left fork for ten minutes; the right one is closed after heavy rain.

nodes.speaker: Wanjiku
nodes.text: Tell him where we started and where we're going. Context turns a vague answer into useful directions.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 回到岔路口时，另一队游客正准备沿错误的箭头前进。雨声很大，你必须迅速提醒他们。

options.text: 「Excuse me, that path is closed. The waterfall trail is on the left.」

nodes.speaker: 游客
nodes.text: Thank you for explaining. We'll follow you until the next marked trail.

nodes.speaker: Wanjiku
nodes.text: Add what is wrong and where to go. A warning helps most when it carries the next step.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 两支临时小队一起走出雨幕。瀑布的声音越来越近，陌生人之间也开始交换雨衣、零食和名字。

nodes.speaker: Wanjiku
nodes.text: Directions are more than left and right. They are a promise that nobody gets left behind.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 【获得 120 金币】雨停时，歪掉的路标已经被扶正，而你记住了如何给出真正有用的方向。
